notes.title: Kris Kringle's Christmas Village VR is taking part in the Steam Summer sale!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

It's winter in June! 
In celebration of the Steam Summer Sale, we've discounted Kris Kringle's Christmas Village VR to 50% for a limited time only!!

With 4 fun and familiar winter activities, this is a great game for those new to VR, or who want a pleasant experience to share with friends and family who are new to VR!  Everything is chill and easygoing- even the little penguins - it's hard not to have a good time in this little Christmas village!

Have fun and stay chill!

[i]LunaBeat[/i]

notes.title: Back our new Kickstarter! "Paranormal Detective: Escape from the 90's"
notes.content:
Great news, everyone!
The Kickstarter for our newest VR game just launched today!

"Paranormal Detective: Escape from the 90's" is an escape room set in an abandoned mall arcade where you have to play arcade games, solve a crime, and fight an evil robot to win.

We've got some radical rewards including limited-edition early bird discounts, as well as tons of fun retro 90's content.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/lunabeat/paranormal-detective-escape-from-the-90s]So check it out and back the campaign today![/url]
